title: Argentinian Apple Empanadas
description: Delicious empanadas filled with sweet caramelized apples, inspired by the flavors of Argentina.

ingredients.name: Empanada dough
ingredients.notes: Thaw frozen dough according to package instructions

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other sweet-tart variety

instructions: Roll out empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add sliced apples, cinnamon, sugar, and nutmeg. Cook, stirring occasionally, until apples are tender and caramelized.
Place a spoonful of apple mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Brush edges with water and fold dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press edges with a fork to seal.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush tops with egg wash and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
